name: Swift-SVD Activation-Aware Compressor — Production-Hardened (v2).
description: Swift-SVD Activation-Aware Compressor — Production-Hardened (v2).  Registered as 'swift_svd_act', 'swift_svd', 'swift_svd_compressor'.  Algorithm:   1. Collect empirical cross-covariance C = E[Y^T X] per layer across      calibration data (online accumulation, bounded memory).   2. Extract principal activation subspaces:        U_act = top-r left  singular vectors of C        V_act = top-r right s

components.name: Factor U (Full-Rank Expansion Projection)
components.math_latex: y_t = z_t (\Sigma_r U_r^\top) + b, \quad U_r \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}

components.name: Residual LoRA / Norm Calibration
components.math_latex: \Delta y_t = x_t (B A)^\top \cdot \frac{\alpha}{r}, \quad A \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times d_{in}}, \; B \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}
